headline: NEW -- Saudi-led coalition intercepts Ansar Allah ballistic missile aimed at Eastern Province
dek: [ATTRIBUTED REPORT] The Saudi-led coalition says its air defences intercepted and destroyed a ballistic missile launched by Yemen's Ansar Allah (Ansar Allah) towards Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province early Thursday. Saudi Civil Defense issued alerts warning of potential danger in Najran and in the…
sources: Saudi-led coalition spokesperson via Reuters (carried by Jerusalem Post) + Times of Israel + Al Jazeera liveblog
fault_line: Saudi air defences holding the oil heartland -- or a sustained Ansar Allah campaign slowly overwhelming them? Intercepts vs Ras Tanura fire is the argument.

sections.what_happened: [ATTRIBUTED REPORT] The Saudi-led coalition says its air defences intercepted and destroyed a ballistic missile launched by Yemen's Ansar Allah (Ansar Allah) towards Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province early Thursday. Saudi Civil Defense issued alerts warning of potential danger in Najran and in the Eastern Province, then said minutes later the danger had passed in both areas. No casualties reported in retrieved material. Context: this follows Tuesday's barrage (3 missiles Eastern Province + 4 drones south + 2 missiles over Riyadh with debris damage) and Wednesday's Taif intercept.
sections.what_verified: 3 distinct declared families: Reuters T1 (JPost piece is by Reuters), Times of Israel T3, Al Jazeera T2 STATE (QA). Coalition claim is attributed, not independently confirmed; no Ansar Allah claim for this specific missile retrieved.
sections.what_disputed: No Ansar Allah claim for this specific Eastern Province missile retrieved; Ansar Allah claims for Tuesday's wider barrage (Ras Tanura refinery hit, Riyadh defence ministry, airports) remain unconfirmed by Saudi authorities, with Bloomberg citing a person familiar saying a fire near Ras Tanura's terminal was contained.
sections.why_matters: Fresh missile at Saudi Arabia's oil east -- intercepted, but it is the third axis in three days: Riyadh, Taif, now the Eastern Province. Brent near $115. The question is not one missile, it is the pace.
sections.context: Background: NEW (missed by 0600 scan) -- Saudi-led coalition intercepts Ansar Allah ballistic missile aimed at Eastern Province; Civil Defense alerts in Najran + Eastern Province, then all-clear

totw_analysis: Our read: Fresh missile at Saudi Arabia's oil east -- intercepted, but it is the third axis in three days: Riyadh, Taif, now the Eastern Province. Brent near $115. The question is not one missile, it is the pace. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Saudi air defences holding the oil heartland -- or a sustained Ansar Allah campaign slowly overwhelming them? Intercepts vs Ras Tanura fire is the argument.
